headline: Binance says it aims to start reopening withdrawals in phases this weekend and publish reserve results on 2 Nov, after Wall Street closed sharply lower on Friday and bitcoin headed for a losing October.

market.asOf: Read from CoinMarketCap at about 00:00 UTC Sat 31 Oct (07:00 Bangkok). Check the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 35 out of 100 on CoinMarketCap's Crypto Fear and Greed Index, read about 00:00 UTC 31 Oct.

stories.title: Binance aims to restart withdrawals in phases this weekend, reserve results on 2 Nov
stories.summary: In a Friday-afternoon update Binance said it aims to begin restoring withdrawals in phases in about 34 hours, once security checks are done. Deposits keep working. Results of a Proof of Reserves check (a public test that customer balances are fully backed) are due on Monday 2 Nov.
points: Binance plans to begin restoring withdrawals in phases 'within approximately 34 hours, subject to the completion of security checks', per Forbes. Bloomingbit reports Binance expects to restore withdrawals by Sunday.
The first reserve snapshot was to be taken within 12 hours of the update, with results announced on 2 November, per ChainCatcher.

Binance has set aside more than $6.34B, including about $5B already held in the affected tokens, per ChainCatcher. Sources word the cover differently: ChainCatcher says about 80% of the affected amount; Bloomingbit quotes Teng saying Binance will fully compensate losses from its own funds.
CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said on CNBC the breach shows 'these are unregulated offshore exchanges', and pitched a 'federal option' for offshore venues to register with the CFTC, per Decrypt.

stories.title: Wall Street closes sharply lower, and bitcoin heads for a losing October
stories.summary: Friday's tech sell-off held into the close, landing on the same day as the Binance hack news. The October figures for bitcoin below were each measured at a different time, before the month ended.
points: Final closes: Nasdaq down 2.84%, S&P 500 down 1.83% and Dow down 1.06%, per TheStreet; The Wall Street Republic has the Nasdaq down 2.86% and the Dow down 1.09%.
Intel fell 28.58% to $65.76, per The Wall Street Republic.
CoinDesk had bitcoin at about $76,300 and down 8.4% for October at 3:24pm ET Friday; Cryptonews, citing CoinGlass, had it down 7.7%, its worst October since 2014.

stories.title: Following the stolen money: estimates differ on how much was taken and frozen
stories.summary: Blockchain trackers are still counting. The figures differ by source, so both are given. The latest tracking found did not show the attacker sending funds to an exchange, mixer or bridge.
points: Amount stolen: Binance says $6.3B; blockchain analytics firm TRM puts it at about $6.36B across 10 blockchains, per Al Jazeera.
Amount frozen: Binance says about $3B; Bitquery counts about $2.7B, including about 1.76B USDT frozen by Tether and 823M USDC by Circle.
Bitquery found about $3.2B still held by the attacker at 06:43 UTC on 30 Oct, with 'none of it sent to a known exchange, a mixer or a bridge'.

briefs.title: Liquidations near $1.6B
briefs.summary: Forced closures of leveraged bets jumped to $1.57B as the hack news hit, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETFs took in $440.8M before the hack
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs drew a net $440.8M over 26-29 Oct, per Farside data; Thursday alone was $17.2M.

briefs.title: Coinbase Q3
briefs.summary: Coinbase reported net income of $719M and adjusted net income of $78M; prediction markets passed $200M in annualized revenue.

briefs.title: Strategy slides on CFO exit
briefs.summary: Strategy shares fell 11% after the departure of its finance chief was disclosed, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Tether reports $1.5B Q3 profit
briefs.summary: Tether's excess reserves rose to $7.95B from $4.1B, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Aave reopens its markets
briefs.summary: Aave reopened its V3 and V4 markets after a precautionary freeze; USDT, USDC, XAUT and PAXG can't yet back new loans.

briefs.title: Market makers disclose Binance exposure
briefs.summary: GSR said its exposure is under 5% of net equity and Wintermute under 20%; neither confirmed losses, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Oil up 15% in October
briefs.summary: US oil (WTI) settled at $104.12 on Friday, up 15.2% for the month, per The Wall Street Republic.

calendar.event: Binance aims to begin reopening withdrawals in phases
calendar.note: On Friday afternoon Binance said about 34 hours, subject to security checks, per Forbes. No exact time given.

calendar.event: Token unlocks: M, EIGEN, SUI, ZETA, 2Z, ENA, BTW, Q, KITE, MMT, HYPE
calendar.note: See the unlock table on this page for sizes, dates and confidence. US clocks go back one hour on Sun 1 Nov: from then, Bangkok is ET+12.
Results to be announced on 2 Nov, per ChainCatcher. No time given.

calendar.note: Bank Rate 3.75%. Sources disagree: Newsquawk and InvestingLive expect a hike to 4.00%; CMC Markets expects a hold.

Prior +29K jobs and 4.2% unemployment. Consensus differs: Newsquawk +55K, CMC Markets about +60K, InvestingLive +63K, Economic Weekly +65K. A bitcoin options expiry of about $1.29B is also due Friday on Deribit, per Tokenist.
